contents.text: {"answer":"The failure described by the owner differs from the defect in recall 24V064000: the owner reports that no airbags deployed during either impact. The recall concerns a front passenger seat weight sensor that can fail to suppress the airbag, leading to unintended deployment—not failure to deploy. That is why the recorded decision is related but different, rather than a match; it does not establish whether this particular vehicle is included in the recall.","scope":"answered","recheck":false,"citations":[{"kind":"complaint","id":"11633527","quote":"Zero  airbags were deployed with either impact."},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V064000","quote":"The front passenger seat weight sensor may crack and short circuit, failing to suppress the air bag as intended."},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V064000","quote":"An air bag that deploys unintentionally during a crash can increase the risk of injury."}]}
